Description

This creature is an immense four-legged, four-winged flying blue snake, fringed with bright purple feathers. - Imban

Defense

AC 37, touch 9, flat-footed 34 (+3 Dex, +28 natural, -4 size)

hp 542 [682] (31d10+372)

Fort +28, Ref +22, Will +19

DR 20/magic; Immune blind, confusion, poison, zombie

Offense

Speed 40 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 60 ft. (good)

Melee bite +42 (3d8+14/19-20 plus confusion), 4 claws +41 (1d6+14 plus grab), 4 wings +39 (1d6+7 plus poison), tail slap +39 (3d6+7 plus blind)

Space 20 ft.; Reach 20 ft.

Special Attacks Blaster, Breath Wing, constrict (3d8+14), Crypt Dust, Demon Eye, Maelstrom, Poison Breath, Zombie Breath

Special Abilities Paraclete, Summon Dark Elementals

Statistics

Str 38, Dex 16, Con 32, Int 12, Wis 25, Cha 12

Base Atk +31; CMB +49 (+53 grapple); CMD 62 (cannot be tripped)

Feats Cleave, Cleaving Finish, Critical Focus, Dodge, Flyby Attack, Improved Critical (Bite), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack, Staggering Critical, Stunning Critical, Toughness, Weapon Focus (Bite)

Skills Climb +56, Fly +35, Perception +45; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception

Languages Draconic, Necril, Umbran

Ecology

Environment ruins

Organization solitary (plus two Dark Elementals)

Treasure standard

description.value: A grand aevis can send out a pulse of electricity at a single target within 30 ft. The grand aevis must make a ranged touch attack (+30), if it hits, the target takes 6d6 points of lightning damage and must make a Fortitude save (DC 31) or be inflicted with Immobilize status for 1d4 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

description.value: The dread gaze from a grand aevis's eyes works as a gaze attack, inflicting the Statue status permanently, with a range of 15 feet, Fortitude DC 31 negates. A creature which successfully saves against a grand aevis's Demon Eye is immune to this effect from the same grand aevis for 24 hours.

description.value: Once every 1d3+1 rounds, a grand aevis can unleash a black, draining wind upon its enemies. All enemies in a 20-ft.-radius burst, with a range of 30 feet, must make a Fortitude save (DC 31) or be reduced to a number of hit points equal to their HD. Those who are already at such a level of hit points or lower are reduced to 1 hit point instead. A successful saving throw reduces the enemy's current hit points by one quarter instead. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 9th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 33).
